sealed_story_packet.headline: ProvenanceGuard checks whether an MCP agent cited the right source, not just a true fact
verified_visual_facts: A multi-tool MCP agent answer is decomposed into individual claims.
Each claim retains or receives a source identity.
Support and attribution are checked separately for each claim.
The verifier produces allow, block or repair outcomes without pooling all evidence anonymously.
